question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?
rendered: According to the text, the cathode delivered 306 mAh/gS at cycle 1500 at 1C. In the rate test, the cathode showed a reversible capacity of 370 mAh/gS at high rates of 1C.
